title: KestrelCare Facility Relations: Repeat-Error Handling Charge
content:
A repeat-error handling charge is added to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts recovery for a facility relationship that has already needed recoveries, counted from the recoveries booked on the plan in the last twelve months:

- two or more add the multiple-error handling charge of 50.00 USD;
- exactly one adds the single-error handling charge of 25.00 USD;
- none adds nothing.

The recoveries counted are the payment recovery entries on the plan's history dated within the twelve months before the day of the recovery. The handling charge is added in full to the amount figured on the payment itself, and the total is rounded to the cent.

| Recoveries on the plan in the last twelve months | Handling charge |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 25.00 |
| 2 or more | 50.00 |

*Hypothetical:* an amount of 342.00 figured on the payment, on a plan with one recovery booked five months earlier, gives a recovery of 367.00; with two earlier recoveries, 392.00.
